Messages.Author: Murphy Christopher J
Messages.Body:
I can play 2 Master cards a turn. (ie: Anson or Rumours of Gehenna)
I steal another Meth.'s Malkavian w/ Malk. Dementia (1st card)
I make it my Blood Doll (2nd card).
Is it my Blood Doll for the rest of the game (ie: after it returns to its
original controller)?

Tom? Official Rulings?

Chris the Hungry

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:



>Tom? Official Rulings?

No, but the current controller can use the Blood Doll. The cards do not
remember who played them (like MtG cards do), so any "you" on the card
is referring to the current controller.
